cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before calling it our discovery, mention who found the receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yes. After my receipt introduced it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put your name in the report.

mechanism: A edits discovery credit with professional precision until the receipt finding is explicitly assigned to A.
confusable: Generic praise would not meet the Drive; S03 distinguishes the documented finding from teamwork or list position.
comparison: Written credit for a financial clue differs from a public tour's recognition of a hidden doorway.
seedUse: Use found-versus-attended credit but establish which receipt and problem rather than relying on unspecified discovery.
